title: Changing the part number warns how many other locations it changes
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • You can switch to a second location, {Location-B} (for example Staging Lethbridge - 4310), in the location switcher in the top bar.
  • You can also switch to a third location, {Location-C} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL Loc 3), in the same location switcher.
  • Part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NUMMSG-01) is stocked at {Location-A} and {Location-B}, active at both, and at {Location-C}, where it is inactive.
  • Part {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NUMMSG-02) is stocked at {Location-A} and {Location-B}.
  • Part {Part-C} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NUMMSG-03) is stocked at {Location-A} only.
custom_steps:
1. At {Location-A}, go to Parts → Inventory and type {Part-A} in the search.
  2. Click the {Part-A} row.
  3. Click at the end of the Part Number and type X.
  4. Press Backspace once.
  5. Click at the start of the Part Number and type two spaces.
  6. Click Cancel.
  7. Type {Part-B} in the search.
  8. Click the {Part-B} row.
  9. Click at the end of the Part Number and type X.
  10. Click Cancel.
  11. Type {Part-C} in the search.
  12. Click the {Part-C} row.
  13. Click at the end of the Part Number and type X.
  14. Click Cancel.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: under Part Number the window shows "This also changes the part number at 2 other locations." ({Location-B}, active, + {Location-C}, inactive = 2: a part that is inactive at another location still counts.)
  • Step 4: the number reads {Part-A} again and the message goes away.
  • Step 5: no message shows: spaces before or after the number are not a change.
  • Step 9: under Part Number: "This also changes the part number at 1 other location."
  • Step 13: no message shows: {Part-C} is stocked at no other location.
  • Steps 6, 10 and 14: the window closes and nothing is saved.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S13-R16, S13-R17, §8 User Feedback Summary, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 2.2 (Both fields edited), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S13-R16: “When the user changes the part number and at least one other location stocks the same Part Library entry, the dialog shows, under the field, "This also changes the part number at {n} other locations.", or "This also changes the part number at 1 other location." for one.”
  • S13-R17: “That message shows only while the typed number differs from the saved one, ignoring spaces before and after it. Parts at other locations count whether they are active or inactive.”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Part number changed on a part other locations stock): “"This also changes the part number at {n} other locations." ("1 other location." for one) | Text under the field while it differs”
